diff_text:
--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,36 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    if tau_filter is True or tau_filter is False:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be Boolean")
+    if not (isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)) and np.isfinite(tau_filter) and tau_filter >= 0):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a nonnegative finite number")
+
+    for name, arr in [('logp_with_result', logp_with_result),
+                      ('logp_call_only', logp_call_only),
+                      ('logp_no_call', logp_no_call)]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a NumPy array")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
+        if arr.size == 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
+        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
+        if np.any(arr > 0):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
+
+    total_with_result = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
+    total_call_only = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
+    total_no_call = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
+
+    max_alternative = np.maximum(total_call_only, total_no_call)
+    improvement = total_with_result - max_alternative
+
+    keep = improvement > tau_filter
+    margins = improvement.astype(np.float64)
+
+    return (keep, margins)
